description: This Java class defines configuration properties for job polling, such as interval, delay, and timeout, using Spring's @Value annotation to inject property values.

classes.name: JobPollingProperties
classes.description: A Spring component that provides configuration properties for job polling intervals, delays, and timeout durations, injected from application properties.

methods.name: getIntervalInMillis
methods.description: Getter method to retrieve the interval between job polls in milliseconds.

methods.name: getDelayInMillis

methods.name: getTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Getter method to retrieve the job polling timeout in milliseconds.
